submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve sprite correction. Edit image1 only, keeping the red fire-talisman BOY identity, camera, whole-canvas framing, head/body size, face, hair, costume and the existing two arm-to-hand chains (RIGHT five-card fan, LEFT bell). Images2–4 preserve this boy's identity and established rendering. Image5 is ONLY a motion/mechanics reference: borrow the clear planted shoe and knee/ankle loading, never the archer girl, bow, green outfit, or her framing. Replace the current hovering forward shoe with an EARLY LANDING pose. The forward FAR anatomical RIGHT leg has now reached the ground; lower its heel to first contact and roll the front shoe almost flat so only a narrow gold outsole edge is visible, not its broad brown sole facing camera. Keep that foot in its existing forward lane, heel-to-toe axis screen lower-left, and knee gently flexed in the same direction. The rear NEAR anatomical LEFT leg stays folded behind, airborne, with its correctly forward-facing shoe axis unchanged. Only reconstruct the front calf/ankle/shoe and necessary knee connection. Distinct two legs. Image5 shows this same far-right-support mechanics. Keep the upper body, limbs ownership, props and canvas positions otherwise unchanged. Output one full1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite. Do not add ground art or shadows. No global rescale or recenter.
